name: Easy Sheet Pan Prosciutto & Herbed Cheese Puff Pastry Tart with Mixed Green Salad

instructions.primary_message: Remove one pastry sheet from box and outer wrapping, then set on the counter to thaw slightly, 20-40 minutes. (The pastry is ready when it unfolds easily but is still cool to the touch.)
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (17.3 oz) pkg frozen puff pastry

instructions.primary_message: When the puff pastry is almost thawed, preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Place egg in a small bowl and whisk to combine the egg wash. Set aside.

Arrange the prosciutto in a square or rectangle that is 2 inches smaller than your puff pastry sheet (e.g. if your puff pastry measures 9 x 10-inches, then your prosciutto should be arranged in a 7 x 8-inch rectangle), overlapping the slices as necessary to get an even layer. Gently press prosciutto together to secure.
Unwrap the cheese and crumble evenly over the prosciutto. Using clean hands, an offset spatula, or a butter knife, gently spread the cheese over the prosciutto in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (5.2 oz) pkg Boursin Gournay cheese, garlic-herb flavor

instructions.primary_message: Lay the thawed puff pastry over the cheese, so that it overlaps the prosciutto-cheese layer by 1-inch on all sides, then brush the top of the pastry with egg wash. Place baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake until the pastry is golden and puffed up, 25-30 minutes. Remove tart from the oven.

When the tart is almost done, wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Place in a medium bowl, along with pumpkin seeds, dried cherries, and dressing, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
¼ cup pumpkin seeds
¼ cup dried cherries
3 tbsp poppy seed dressing

instructions.primary_message: When the tart is done, place a cutting board over the baking sheet (being careful not to crush the puff pastry), then use oven mitts to flip the tart out onto the board. Peel off parchment paper and cut the tart into portions.
To serve, divide tart and salad between plates. Enjoy!
